subject: English
question_text: Fill in the gaps with suitable prepositions, articles and zero articles (a, an, the or x): 0.
stimulus: Friendship is (a)____ great human virtue. It is (b) ____ love and affection between two persons. It binds more than one person (c) ____ good relationship and inspires each other to share (d) ____ joys and sorrows (e) ____ life. Man is (f) ____ social being. He cannot live alone. So, he wants (g) ____ company. He yearns (h) ____ giving and receiving love and affection. Friendship grows between the persons (i) ____ similar taste, feelings and thoughts. It grows out of mutual understanding and give and take. It generally grows (j) ____ two persons of the same age.
guide_solution: (a) a (b) the (c) with (d) the (e) of (f) a (g) × (h) for (i) of (j) between
